messages.content: How many minutes are in one hour? Reply with exactly: 60 minutes.

In 100 to 130 words, explain to a beginner why keeping a separate backup copy of an important document is useful. Include one everyday example, explain how a backup differs from simply renaming the original file, and mention one limitation of backups. Give only the explanation as one paragraph, with no title or bullet list.

Write a fictional story of 300 to 350 words in exactly four paragraphs. A neighborhood opens a small lending library in an unused garden shed. On opening morning, rain reveals a leak in the roof. Follow one volunteer as the neighbors solve the problem together and open the library later that day. Use a calm, hopeful tone, include a brief exchange of dialogue, and end with a child choosing the first book. Give only the story, with no title or commentary.
